propositions: The autodeploy no-op exit path (line 228) does not invoke docker pruning during quiescent main, leaving root disk unclaimed between deploys and causing sustained high-pressure alarm states.
The prune_docker_caches() function is defined after its first intended call site (line 228), making it unreachable; it must be relocated above line 150 to precede the no-op exit.

A pressure-triggered throttled prune on the no-op path, guarded by an absolute threshold (default 80%) and a minimum interval (default 600s), will reclaim disk during quiescence without churning on every tick.
The marker AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE must be emitted exactly once per triggered prune and zero times when below threshold or within throttle window.
Prune failures on the pressure path must not alter the script's exit code or control flow, only log.
